# Native Affinity reader

Vendored from Storytold VectorCraft b12a52f7249e0aa73f030587e05ed9ce0c73ab67, crates/affinity, under MIT. Copyright and license retained in LICENSE-MIT. UPSTREAM.md records original provenance and supported subset. Omadesign adapts compression to the existing zstd dependency with the same 64 MiB window bound; no Affinity software or GPL bridge code is linked. Synthetic builders are test helpers, not an Affinity writer.
